integrity: The proof derives the amplification factor from the published extrapolation recurrence, proves the exact sign boundary by monotonicity of an elementary ratio, and establishes the refinement asymptotic analytically. The packaged checker independently replays the finite algebra and rational sign brackets.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exact two-level Richardson extrapolation of backward Euler on scalar positive linear decay. It does not classify higher extrapolation columns, nonlinear strong-stability-preserving radii, or positivity-preserving modified extrapolation schemes. Equivalent older absolute-monotonicity formulations remain a residual literature risk.
title: Richardson acceleration creates a sharp positivity barrier for backward Euler
